serviceName: Odden custom domain (top of a zone)
description: Lets a workspace in Odden Cloud serve its public pages (landing pages, forms and portals) from a customer's domain at the top of its zone, such as example.com, where a CNAME is not allowed: a TXT record that proves ownership and an A record to Odden. For a subdomain see odden.io.custom-domain.
variableDescription: %verifytoken%: the ownership token Odden issued for the domain (the value after odden-verify=). %ip%: the IPv4 address Odden serves these domains from.
